newsitem.title: USA: CPT solicits Steel of W.Va. proxies.
newsitem.headline: CPT solicits Steel of W.Va. proxies.

text.p: CPT Holdings In said on Monday it has commenced the solicitation of proxies from stockholders of Steel of West Virginia for use at Steel of West Virginia's annual Meeting.

"We are asking SWVA stockholders to vote in support of our proposal requesting that the SWVA board of directors enter into good faith negotiations for the sale of the company with qualified bidders, including CPT," CPT president and chief executive William Remley said in a statement.

CPT Holdings Inc said it is asking Steel of West Virginia stockholders to vote against an increase in authorized common stock, an authorization of preferred stock and the elimination of the stockholders' right to act by written consent.
Also, CPT said that it continues to seek to obtain a copy of SWVA's list of stockholders.
Remley said, "Contrary to SWVA's comments last week, pending litigation...to obtain the stockholder list has not been withdrawn."
